name: Festival Kraf Borneo Sarawak (Sarawak Borneo Craft Festival)
summary: Ten-day craft festival at Kuching Waterfront from 23 October to 1 November 2026, with sales, exhibitions and demonstrations under the Ini Kraf Malaysia theme as part of the Sarawak Regatta–Kuching Waterfront Festival programme.
source_name: DayakDaily — Sarawak Borneo Craft Festival Oct 2026

name: Festival Gendang Melayu Sarawak
summary: Malay drum festival at the Regatta Cultural Stage from 30 October to 1 November 2026, with bermukun, gendang performances, sape music and community cultural showcases during Sarawak Regatta weekend.
source_name: Sarawak Tourism Board — Sarawak Regatta programme
